job.title: Member of Technical Staff, Design Engineering
job.description: GC AI is the legal AI platform built for in-house legal teams. Your decisions shape the product, your impact is immediate, and you own your work from day one. This role involves architecting UI solutions, prototyping interactions, mentoring engineers, and building performant, responsive interfaces for a legal AI platform.
responsibilities: Design and implement complex, accessible front-end components and a reusable design system
Architect UI solutions and prototype interactions
Mentor engineers and improve design-to-development workflows
Champion accessible, responsive, and performant user interfaces for legal teams
Establish best practices for front-end development and component architecture
Create prototypes to explore new interaction models and validate design concepts for legal workflows
Develop tools and processes to improve design-to-development workflow
